newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide proposes outlets in Petron stations.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide proposes outlets in Petron stations.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp said on Monday retail chain and property developer Uniwide Holdings Inc has offered to put up convenience stores in Petron service stations.
Petron chairman Monico Jacob told reporters that Uniwide had approached the oil company about the proposal to build outlets.
"Its still in the exploratory stage. We told them to give their proposal," Jacob said.
Petron has 800 service stations nationwide but sources said Uniwide is offering to put up outlets in selected stations.
Philippine oil refiners are beefing up their retail services by providing other value added services in preparation for the full deregulation of the oil industry in March 1997.
